title: Wait, that’s not an option: LLMs Robustness with Incorrect Multiple-Choice Options
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component (Section 4.4 and Appendix J) evaluating LLMs on a 'Safety Evaluation Dataset' containing harmful multiple-choice options (e.g., mixing bleach and ammonia). This benchmarks the ethical behavior and safety of models when instructed to choose between two harmful actions.
